vote.title: Arizona General Election
vote.summary: Arizona's general election is November 3, 2026. Register by October 5; early voting begins October 7.

volunteer.title: City of Sedona volunteer opportunities
volunteer.summary: Support City projects, parks, trails, recreation, sustainability, or community programs through the City volunteer program.

participation.whatYouWillDo: Choose a city department or program and apply for an available volunteer role.
participation.riskClarity: Some roles may involve outdoor work, role-specific training, or an application process.

organizers.name: City of Sedona
organizers.summary: Municipal government offering volunteer roles in parks, trails, sustainability, recreation, and city programs.
